label: Library
literalRoomDescription: This must have been a large library, probably for the royal family. All of the shelves have been gnawed to pieces by unfriendly gnomes. To the north is an exit.
safeSceneProfile: Royal library with shelves gnawed to pieces by gnomes and north exit. Individual coloured books are observed objects, never unreadable decorative duplicates of puzzle books.

sourceText: Worn and battered in one corner of the room is a blue book.
This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar.

visibleInitialObjects.label: purple book
sourceText: Lying in the dust, and covered with mold, is a purple book.

This book is written in a tongue with which I am unfamiliar. Assuming that one can indeed tell a book by its cover, it is likely filled with purple prose, the like of which is rarely seen outside the Great Underground Empire.

visibleInitialObjects.label: white book
sourceText: Right beside the purple book sits a white one.

It is written in an unfamiliar tongue and details the use of various magical objects, chiefly the so-called "magic wand". Apparently these devices work by pointing them at the object to be ensorcelled, and then chanting the appropriate magic words. (It's truly amazing how credulous these ancients were, isn't it?)
